title: Chapter 6447: Fat Wang

Chapter 6447: Fat Wang

Chapter 6447: Fat Wang

“Why not?” Li Qiye asked.

“You go.” Left told Right to speak to no avail. Thus, he answered: “We promised that we would follow his wish.”

“He will only follow us if he wants to.” Right said.

“I see, so you’re using the dreams to fuse the three souls.” Li Qiye said.

“The dreams will definitely enlarge his mind and ambition. At that point, the boss will return.” Right said.

“What if he doesn’t return? A dream becomes eternal.” Li Qiye said.

“Is that an actual concern?” Left asked Right.

“No way.” Right said.

“You’re not afraid of his dying in the dreams?” Li Qiye asked.

“He can’t, we planted really well.” Right said.

“Well my ass, planting the souls into my springs in my absence.” The skull cursed.

“What? Your longevity spring already had someone there, we only planted the souls.” Right said.

“What? Who? There’s a hidden secret there.” The skull said.

“What secret?” Both Right and Left perked up.

“Tell me who is there first.” The skull said.

“No idea who they are.” Right shook his head.

“A man and a woman, maybe they’re doing something shameful over there.” Left said with a silly grin.

“Bah! Don’t talk about such nasty things.” The skull shouted.

“Not like it really matters to you.” The two stared at the skull, no longer looking foolish.

“What do you mean?” The skull was displeased by their stares.

“Didn’t you lose all your cultivation?” Left said.

“Not only that, he’s pretty much dead.” Right added.

“See, you can barely climb out of your grave, stop worrying so much.” Left continued.

“Damn it, fools! During my prime, little immortals such as yourselves wouldn’t suffice as appetizers.” The skull said.

The two staggered backward, alarmed.

“Afraid?” The skull asked.

“Is he going to eat us?” Left asked.

“He can’t even eat a bug now, let alone us.” Right said.

“Just wait, when I return to life, I’ll celebrate by eating you two first.” The skull intimidated.

“You can really eat us?” Both became afraid.

“Of course, little immortals are easy meals.” The skull said.

“Stop bragging, the primordial beings didn’t eat us when we were back in Heavenrealm.” Right said.

“That’s right, that one geezer who survived a blow from the villainous heaven couldn’t eat us.” Left said.

“Don’t compare me to children.” The skull said.

The two exchanged glances and Right said: “If you’re so amazing, how come you only have a skull left?”

He spoke with curiosity and sincerity, like an obedient student seeking an answer. This infuriated the skull but there was no blood left to vomit.

“Just wait until I’m back, I’ll remember this.” The skull gritted his teeth.

“Are you going to Heavenrealm?” Left asked.

“Why would I?” The skull said.

“Because we’re returning. You’ll have to come if you want to eat us.” Right said.

“No, you will die on the way.” The skull said with disdain.

“We didn’t die on the journey here and even if you return, you might not be able to eat us.” Left said.

“And why’s that?” The skull asked.

‘Because Fat Wang will eat you first.” Left said.

“That’s right.” Right chimed in.

“Fat Wang?” The skull asked.

“A fatty who is really good at eating, not a good fellow.” Right said.

“He’s the worst glutton, even more than Lord Zhao. You don’t know how many he had eaten, legend has it he ate a primordial immortal before.” Left said.

“Oh? What is his background?” The skull became serious.

“No idea, laws cannot cut him.” Left said.

“It’s not that, he’s good at hiding so no one can find him.” Right said.

“Can’t be that capable if he couldn’t eat you two.” The skull said.

“Because we are even better at hiding.” Left and Right responded.

“Lord Zhao does it too but no one talks about it.” Left mumbled.

“Okay, enough talking, go return the three souls.” Li Qiye waved and ordered.

“You go do it.” The twins responded.

“Why me?” Li Qiye glared at them.

“He won’t come out if it’s us, not to mention the promise. You can do it for sure.” The two shook their head but were eventually intimidated by Li Qiye’s stare.

“Only responsible for the planting, nothing else I see.” Li Qiye said.

The two smiled wryly. Left said: “Well, he won’t die...”

“It will just take a while. One day, he might randomly want to go to Heavenrealm.” Right said.

“This shows how little you two understand him.” Li Qiye said.

“We don’t understand him? We were together for so long.” The two disagreed.

“It’s difficult to be one’s true self.” Li Qiye smiled and then added: “I’ll go.”

“Please come back soon.” The two said excitedly.

Li Qiye glared one more time before delving into the dreams.

***

“These two taking advantage of my springs, I’ll teach them a lesson later.” The skull said.

“Can’t even teach an ant a lesson right now.” Li Qiye chuckled.

“Sigh, when a tiger is down, even the dogs crowd around.” The skull lost his spirit.

“Be more optimistic. If you let go and try again to surpass yourself, maybe you’ll become a second him.” Li Qiye said.

“How long would that take? All the worlds might be destroyed by your group then.” The skull said.

“We’ll see.” Li Qiye smiled and eventually found the right dream.

“Here.” He said.

“This is Splendor Spring.” The skull said.
